name: io.github.csoai-org/meok-cross-post
description: openMCP: audit + cross-post tool for MCP servers. Scores an MCP server repo 0-100 for listing-readiness and cross-posts it to Smithery, the MCP Registry, Docker MCP Catalog, Glama, MCPize, and PulseMCP -- the discovery layer for the MEOK EU AI Act / DORA / NIS2 / CRA compliance fleet. MCP server, AI governance tooling, agent compliance audit.
_deploymentNote: The `remotes[0].url` below is a LAUNCH PLACEHOLDER. Set it to the real public streamable-http endpoint at deploy time before publishing to the MCP Registry. Remote-only listing (no published package) is registry-valid; the PyPI package below is an optional second install path and may be omitted if PyPI is not yet published.
